name: up

options.description: Start the project's Compose infrastructure as well.
Merge this project Compose file last, overriding docker-dev.

help: Starts the persistent development container and opens a shell. custom-compose.yml is applied after docker-dev's base, plugin and port configuration. Use --merge-compose to include the project's Compose infrastructure; --merge-file selects one explicitly and applies it last, overriding all other Compose files.
